Synthetic cohort only — outputs are **not** paper results.

Trait association heatmaps (sex/APOE and `SIG.CLUSTERS`) and proteomics density
Wilcoxon (`23`/`33` vs `34`/`44`).

CLI equivalent: `Rscript notebooks/03_trait_proteomics.R` (from `DeepDynamics/analyses/`).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r run}
source("notebooks/03_trait_proteomics.R")
```

## Sex and APOE trait heatmaps

```{r ta-sex-apoe, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
grid.arrange(
  grid.grabExpr(draw(p.sex, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")),
  grid.grabExpr(draw(p.apoe, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")),
  ncol = 2
)
```

## States × pathologies heatmap

```{r ta-states, fig.width=14, fig.height=4}
draw(p.states, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
```

## Proteomics density

```{r proteomics, fig.width=5, fig.height=3.5}
print(p)
```
